comments.author: booger
comments.body_html: a mod like this works by polling the game every x amount of time for the info it wants, in this case the number of bots on the server. if it does so too frequently, that can definitely cause lag, but usually you’ll see that if it’s doing that like, a couple hundred or thousand times a second. for something like this where the number you’re checking changes infrequently, it’s good enough to check it every minute or so which basically avoids any lag the request will cause. you can see this in mice sometimes if you turn your dpi up too high, same concept.

comments.author: Schluid
comments.body_html:
Hey! Thank you, really glad to hear the mod is helpful.

From a quick look at the source code for “Rogues Vs Raiders”, it seems they are using the standard vanilla Tarkov IDs for their spawns. Because of that, BotCounter should normally be able to pick them up just fine.

If your counter is consistently showing 0, my guess is that the other mod might just be struggling to actually spawn them into the map. I don’t use or test that mod myself, so I can’t say for 100% sure, but that would be my best guess based on how BotCounter works.

Cheers
